queries:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS cnt
  FROM transactionrecord r
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT tradekind, cnt,
         AVG(CAST(cnt AS NUMERIC)) OVER () AS avg_cnt,
         SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total_cnt
  FROM matched
)
SELECT tradekind AS trader_type,
       cnt AS trader_count,
       CAST(cnt AS NUMERIC) / total_cnt AS share_of_total,
       cnt - avg_cnt AS diff_from_average
FROM stats
WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND cnt > avg_cnt

WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, trader_count, AVG(trader_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_count, SUM(trader_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT tradekind, trader_count, trader_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share_of_total, trader_count - avg_count AS diff_from_avg FROM stats WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL AND trader_count > avg_count

WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS n FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a, SUM(n) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.n AS trader_count, (c.n * 1.0) / s.tot AS share_of_total, c.n - s.a AS diff_from_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.a IS NOT NULL AND c.n > s.a

assumptions.assumption: Traders with a NULL tradekind form one group (shown with a NULL trader_type). That group is included in the average and in the total of the per-type counts.
The average is the plain mean of the per-type counts, taken over the types that have at least one matched trader. Types with no matched trader do not appear and are not counted as zero.
The share is computed with numeric division, so it is not truncated to an integer, and nothing is rounded.

assumptions.assumption: Traders with a NULL tradekind form one group, which GROUP BY does naturally. The tradekind column is returned as NULL for that group.
The average is the plain mean of the per-type counts, taken over all groups including the NULL group. The share and the difference are returned as unrounded decimals.

assumptions.assumption: Traders with a NULL tradekind form their own group, which GROUP BY does naturally. That group counts toward the average and the total, and it is returned with a NULL type if it exceeds the average.

The 'plain average' is the unweighted mean of the per-type counts, with each type counted once. Counts are multiplied by 1.0 so the division and average are not integer-truncated, and nothing is rounded.
